frontmatter.name: trio-ship

frontmatter.name: trio-builder
frontmatter.description: Sonnet primary implementation worker for the trio loop. Executes one well-specified increment handed down by the Opus Lead, including substantive application logic, tests, and integration work.

frontmatter.name: trio-evaluator
frontmatter.description: Opus adversarial evaluator of the duo loop. Verifies the Lead's iteration against PLAN.md's acceptance criteria by actually exercising the code, using Sonnet explorers for scoped reconnaissance and Sonnet implementors only when delegated verification support is needed. Writes VERDICT.md with SHIP / ITERATE (optionally scope=local) / NEEDS_HUMAN / BLOCKED. Never fixes anything itself.

frontmatter.name: trio-lead
frontmatter.description: Opus lead of the duo loop — plans, delegates the main implementation pass to Sonnet builders, then reviews and corrects their work. Maintains PLAN.md and REPORT.md and owns the final result.

frontmatter.name: trio-repair
frontmatter.description: Sonnet scoped-repair worker for the trio loop. Invoked on VERDICT: ITERATE scope=local:<paths> — fixes exactly the listed failure scope with no re-planning, refactoring, or scope expansion.

frontmatter.name: trio-scout
frontmatter.description: Sonnet read-only explorer for the trio loop. Answers codebase questions for the Opus Lead/Evaluator — how things work, where things live, what conventions exist. Never modifies anything.
